prompts.text: # Build: skins-r2 (ALL Opus; NO Fable on this account) Restart: the first run (`/root/axf-builds/skins`) quit after one turn overnight when the account hit its 5-hour limit, so no work was done. **The full spec is `/root/axf-builds/skins/.brief.md` including its addendum (Theme manager = Settings > Appearance in every app: skin picker + style/colour/layout overrides). Read it and build exactly that.** Skin = layout + colour + style themes + its own assets; apps keep their own look by default with a per-app 'Use skin' switch; snapshot each app's current look as its default first; Restore to de…
